plugins.name: dev-loop
plugins.description: Development loop as composable skills — research, plan, implement, review, ship — with /work running the whole chain. Each writes markdown into .dev-loop/ that the next one reads. Stack rules come from each repo's AGENTS.md.

plugins.name: authoring
plugins.description: Create and maintain Claude Code skills, agents, and AGENTS.md files (create-skill, create-agent, meta).

plugins.name: majksa-deploy
plugins.description: Release-train deploy through MajNet (GitOps): cut release tags → stable auto-deploys; production via the admin-gated env/production render PR in the project's ops repo; deploy config edits on ops main. App/org specifics read from the host repo's config section.

plugins.name: notion-sprint
plugins.description: Notion sprint lifecycle: pick up work, complete items, reconcile statuses after merges. Board/database specifics read from the host repo's config section.

plugins.name: diagnose
plugins.description: Read-only production diagnosis via SigNoz (logs/traces), Coolify deploy state, and Postgres.

plugins.name: worktree
plugins.description: Tool-agnostic herdr worktree launcher: open a branch in an isolated worktree, run a Claude agent in it with a given prompt, remove the worktree when that agent exits.

plugins.name: mac-notify
plugins.description: macOS notification (with sound) whenever Claude Code needs your attention.
